tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags pa rin po che'i phyi rten 'bum thang gi gter 'bum gyi gtsug lag khang gi zhig gsos logs bris gser thog spos pa sogs kyi dkar chag bzhugs lags// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /gong ma rnams kyi phyi rten sku 'bum mchog /byin rlabs chu rgyun dngos su 'byung rnams la/ /nyams gso zhabs tog rim par bgyid rnams dang / /lhag par kun 'dzin zhes bya byi ba'i lo/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i phyi rten gtor 'bum zhes/ /yongs grags de yi gtsug lag khang chen dang / /mchod rten nyid la nyams gsos zhabs tog bcas/ /steng gi bla lding gser phigs mdog 'don dang / /shing cha gsar du spos dang lhan cig tu/ /nang gi logs bris rtsa brgyud bla ma yi/ /sku brnyan mchog dang 'od dpag med pa yi/ /zhing khams bde ba can gyi bkod pa dang / /snang ba mtha' yas sku brnyan brgya phrag lnga/ /sum cu lnga bcas sngon med ngo mtshar gyi/ /bkod pa gsar du bskrun pa'i snang brnyan 'di/ /'khon gyi rigs skyes sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /chos med ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pas bzhengs/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob sgrib kun byang gyur nas/ /dus 'dir don kun lhun grub bstan pa rgyas/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /khyad par grogs mchog puṇ+ya rasmi de/ /da lta mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing skyes nas/ /rmi lam mjal zhing sprul pas don byed shog /ci ste da lta rigs drug gnas skyes na/ /de nas 'phos 'phral de ma thag nyid du/ /dag pa'i zhing bsgrod bdag cag dpon slob gnyis/ /'phrad nas ngo shes sprul pa dpag med kyis/ /bstan pa spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa'i/ /bstan 'di nam langs nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i mthu ldan shog

/don de de bzhin nyid du nges gyur cig /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gtsug lag khang gi zhig gsos logs bris gser thog spos pa sogs kyi dkar chag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
